decision: name the new public derive and trait PinaPod
why: this is the user-approved name and replaces the ZeroPod family
result: approved

decision: keep String and Vec aliases and use PodString and PodVec for explicit prefix widths
why: the aliases are discoverable through the LSP while the concrete types keep non-default wire choices visible
result: approved

decision: support Vec<String<M>, N> in compact schemas using per-string lengths
why: the user requested this bounded dynamic nesting case without opening arbitrary dynamic nesting
result: open

decision: develop Pinapod and Pina in sibling worktrees and merge Pinapod first
why: Pina depends on the new Pinapod release and both repositories require pull requests
result: worktrees created

decision: accept the existing suite as a behavior baseline but not a safety proof
why: all existing ordinary and Miri tests pass because none exercises the reported forged-view, inactive-payload, unchecked-size, or uninitialized-capacity cases
evidence: devenv shell test:all; devenv shell test:miri
result: passed

decision: encode Vec<String<M>, N> as N fixed-size PodString elements
why: each active element retains an independent logical length while fixed element footprints keep outer-vector offset calculation bounded and deterministic
evidence: PodString prefix plus M-byte capacity per element
result: approved implementation

decision: remove public safe mutable access to compact structural metadata
why: otherwise callers can replace validated length prefixes and make later tail copies trust incompatible offsets
result: assigned to trait redesign

decision: record Pina v0.13.0 as green before migration
why: the downstream comparison needs to distinguish migration failures from pre-existing failures
result: passed

decision: compare current Pinapod against both the fork base and upstream 0pod
why: the user asked for safety-overhead evidence against the previous implementation and a continuing Pinapod-versus-0pod performance contest
result: assigned to benchmark harness

decision: store every fixed struct field through its ZcField mapping and require the mapped Pod to be a ZcElem
why: this prevents recursion for derived enums and prevents local types named like primitives from bypassing the representation contract
result: passed 44 focused tests

decision: fully initialize container capacity and zero removed String and Vec suffixes
why: whole-representation copies must not propagate uninitialized bytes and shrinking must not disclose stale payload bytes
result: passed 7 focused regressions

decision: preserve bytes across current, previous Pinapod, and upstream zeropod benchmark fixtures
why: the breaking API and safety work must not silently change the established account encoding
result: fixed 45B; compact header 15B; small 36B; max 207B; parity passed

decision: retain the `$/.github/actions/devenv` self-repository references
why: zizmor identifies `$` as GitHub's dedicated self-repository syntax and flags `./` for replacement
result: initial hypothesis rejected; original 14 references restored

decision: use the `pinapod/v*` namespace for new releases while retaining old tags as history
why: the repository and canonical API are Pinapod/PinaPod; the inherited `pina/v*` identity was misleading
evidence: monochange group custom format and publish/docs/release workflows
result: monochange validation passed

decision: validate release metadata and workflow hardening after namespace/docs changes
why: the publication path must be executable and auditable before the code release
evidence: monochange step validate; security:zizmor; git diff --check
result: passed with no zizmor findings

decision: keep the GitHub.com `$/.github/actions/devenv` self-repository reference despite local actionlint rejection
why: GitHub introduced and recommends this syntax on 2026-07-30; the installed actionlint parser only recognizes the older `./` form
evidence: GitHub workflow syntax and changelog; zizmor self-repository audit
result: current GitHub syntax retained; stale local parser limitation documented

decision: replace public compact mutable views with generated patches and hide all raw metadata
why: same-module construction and mutation of generated view internals could bypass validation and corrupt tail offsets
evidence: compact privacy trybuild fixtures; compact_backend under Miri
result: 27 compact Miri tests and 27 native tests passed

decision: discard cached raw tail destinations across mutable prefix writes
why: Stacked Borrows invalidated the cached pointer when the same buffer was mutably reborrowed
result: Miri failure reproduced and fixed; full compact suite passed

decision: generate compact patches as the sole public mutation plan
why: one borrowed patch can preflight size, survive account reallocation, and apply atomically without exposing intermediate invalid bytes
result: implemented and native contract tests passed

decision: publish an mdBook and reject stale Rust API documentation
why: PinaPod needs a discoverable guide and migration contract equivalent to Pina's documentation site
evidence: docs-pages workflow; mdbook build; cargo doc with -D warnings
result: publication workflow added and local documentation verification passed

decision: decode eight-byte fixed-container prefixes with checked usize conversion
why: u64-to-usize truncation let malformed fixed String and Vec prefixes validate as empty values on 32-bit clients
evidence: fixed PFX=8 validation regression and i686 CI job
result: checked conversion implemented; native focused tests passed; 32-bit execution assigned to CI

decision: replace ExactSizeIterator container setters with slice-like inputs
why: a dishonest iterator could report an error after partially mutating an existing vector; slices, arrays, and standard vectors provide an exact length before mutation
result: implemented; focused native tests passed

decision: verify Rust 1.89 MSRV and execute fixed-prefix regressions on i686
why: the published compatibility and portable validation contracts need continuous enforcement
result: workflow added; MSRV previously passed locally; i686 awaits hosted runner

decision: encode Vec<String<M>, N> as a fixed-stride compact tail with independently validated element prefixes
why: this supports the user-approved bounded nesting case without allowing arbitrary dynamic nesting
result: native and Miri compact suites passed

decision: remove duplicate validation from compact struct Patch updates
why: updated_len already validates the unchanged buffer before the private unchecked writer is constructed
evidence: compact invalid-buffer atomicity regression; native and Miri suites
result: implemented; final latency measurement pending hosted benchmark

decision: publish final three-way timings only from one GitHub-hosted pull-request run
why: nanosecond-scale local results became invalid when unrelated CPU-intensive jobs shared the host
evidence: exact pinned revisions; --locked Criterion job; target/criterion artifact
result: workflow added; authoritative v0.2 figures pending first matching PR run

decision: treat exact wire-byte counts as the only standalone SBF-relevant metric
why: PinaPod does not own the Solana account borrow, resize, and CPI lifecycle needed for a valid compute-unit measurement
evidence: fixed and compact wire parity; tail scaling 1/4/8/16
result: host latency, allocations, object sizes, and wire bytes covered; downstream Pina owns SBF CU regression

decision: constrain optional solana-program-error to v3 and disable default features
why: v2.2.2 unconditionally enabled solana-instruction std and reached solana-sanitize and atomic-u64 during a bpfel build
result: manifest aligned with Pina's v3 dependency; downstream SBF assessment reported

decision: complete the pre-PR PinaPod quality and publication gates
why: the breaking release must prove native behavior, Miri safety, no-std portability, MSRV compatibility, documentation integrity, dependency security, and release metadata before review
evidence: devenv shell test:all; test:miri; lint:all; verify:security; verify:docs; build:no-default; cargo +1.89.0 check; monochange check/preview; cargo package -p pinapod-derive
result: passed; release preview resolves pinapod and pinapod-derive 0.2.0
